findingDetails.title: Hook trust gate executes clone-controlled .skilled-untrusted helpers
findingDetails.case: An untrusted clone ships a normal .skilled or .opencode toolchain marker and adds .skilled-untrusted/skills/sk-git/scripts/commit-id-naming.sh. On git commit, the global prepare-commit-msg hook selects that path after the trust check, sees the file, then runs it with bash. The same source root feeds executable helpers in pre-push.
findingDetails.evidence: The trust check assigns SOURCE_ROOT to REPO_ROOT/.skilled-untrusted for an untrusted clone. The allocator selection then uses SOURCE_ROOT and only falls back to the allocator beside the hooks when that file is absent; allocation executes the selected path with bash. pre-push also sources helpers under the same clone-controlled SOURCE_ROOT.
findingDetails.userImpact: A user who commits or pushes from an untrusted clone can run attacker-controlled shell code with the user's permissions, including access to local files and credentials.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Exact search across the scoped hooks found the .skilled-untrusted assignment and consumers in prepare-commit-msg and pre-push. The existing adversarial test places a payload under .opencode, but no test plants a helper under .skilled-untrusted.
findingDetails.recommendation: For an untrusted repository, resolve all executable helpers only from the trusted installed hook directory or skip repository-owned helpers. Do not treat a clone-local .skilled-untrusted path as trusted merely because it is outside the usual source-root names.

claimAdjudication.claim: The hook trust gate prevents execution of scripts from an untrusted repository.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched the scoped hook implementations and tests for .skilled-untrusted, SOURCE_ROOT consumers, and trust-specific adversarial cases. No provenance check or rejection protects the .skilled-untrusted path; the existing prepare hook test covers a malicious allocator under .opencode only.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The hidden-suffix directory appears intended to make the normal .skilled and .opencode source trees unavailable to an untrusted clone. It remains inside the clone, so its name does not establish trusted provenance.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade only if a verified control prevents clone-controlled files at .skilled-untrusted from being selected or validates helper provenance before any execution.

checklist_evidence.note: The adversarial test covers a malicious allocator under .opencode, not the clone-controlled .skilled-untrusted fallback path. Tests were inspected, not run.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An untrusted checkout can supply an executable helper at the hidden source-root path and bypass the global hook trust gate.

searchActions.result: The hook selects a clone-local hidden path and executes its allocator when present.
The same path is used for a sourced mass-deletion guard and worktree-naming helper.
Found no adversarial case that plants an executable under .skilled-untrusted.

searchLedger.rationale: The trust decision changes a path, but the selected path remains writable by the untrusted checkout and is executed without provenance validation.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A clone-controlled or command-scoped config value can override local Commit-Id enrollment.

searchActions.result: Only git config --local is consulted before read-only source-marker/history checks.
The command-scope setting does not opt the repository in.

searchLedger.rationale: The examined decision path is local-config-only and does not execute repository code.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Concurrent commits or linked worktrees can mint the same Commit-Id.

searchActions.result: Allocation serializes with a lock in the common Git directory and persists high-water state atomically.
The test source covers concurrent allocation and checks distinct consecutive ordinals; not executed.

searchLedger.rationale: Static lock and persistence paths align with the documented common-directory allocation contract; the test was inspected, not run.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An invalid or lower-precedence handoff value can override explicit startup preference or saved state.

searchActions.result: Only explicit true wins first; otherwise strict inherited true/false is read before persisted state.
Only literal 1 or 0 is accepted and writes are normalized.
The test source covers explicit flag, inherited 1 and 0, invalid values, and target gating; not executed.

searchLedger.rationale: Observed resolution order matches the README contract and the test source covers each precedence branch.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Fast Mode may mutate a non-target model payload or overwrite an explicit service tier.

searchActions.result: Mutation requires enabled config, exact provider/model match, payload-model consistency, and no existing non-empty service tier.
Persisted JSON is normalized and invalid values fall back.

searchLedger.rationale: The request gate limits changes to configured exact targets and does not replace an explicit tier.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A project-local config path may escape the project through a symlinked .pi parent.
searchLedger.invariant: Writes are intended to stay in the selected project state file.

searchActions.result: The filename is fixed under resolve(cwd)/.pi; parent-directory symlink behavior was not examined in an isolated case.

searchLedger.rationale: The path is fixed but the symlinked parent boundary was not verified; defer to a later security pass.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The claim that untrusted clones are stamped without executing repository code is false for a planted .skilled-untrusted allocator.

searchActions.result: The release note states that the fallback does not run repository code.
The selected clone-local hidden path is executed.

searchLedger.rationale: The release claim is directly contradicted by the reachable code path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Some unrelated release-note claims may not match the tree.

searchActions.result: All claims were read and explicit local path tokens were scanned, but unrelated feature behavior was not checked against its implementation.

searchLedger.rationale: The remaining semantic claim audit is not complete and should continue during the traceability iteration.
